# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering corrections** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157 previews Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and GPU correctness fixes. The release also makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Release Candidate 2 adds transformed-shape and displacement-filter corrections, safer Graphite clip recording and native Vulkan wait-result handling without changing managed API signatures.

## Breaking Changes

- **Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15** — Graphite Metal's native runtime minimum rises to iOS and tvOS 15; macOS remains at 12. If you use this backend, raise deployment targets as needed and continue to satisfy any higher managed or framework requirements. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia m157 engine** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 157 while preserving the managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Explicit cdecl for LibraryImport** — SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp and companion bindings now explicitly select cdecl for LibraryImport, matching existing DllImport paths. This addresses an ABI mismatch that can affect Windows x86; runtime confirmation of the reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))
- **Safer rasterization and glyph replay** — Fixes convex anti-aliased path buffer overflow across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and device-space bounds. Direct-mask Slug replay rejects unsupported fractional cases and gains validation at deserialization and draw time. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **Correct GPU geometry and text selection** — Corrects reflected zero-length square hairline caps, transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry, overlapping corner radii and text-atlas sampler selection. Empty Ganesh flushes no longer leave stale atlas work, and displacement offsets use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Graphite clipping and readback corrections** — Fixes clip-key packing, wedge inflation and alpha-to-RGBx GPU readback stride. Clip recording counts pending clip elements before flushing; a draw whose clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass is warned about and skipped rather than exceeding pass capacity. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Vulkan synchronization and cleanup** — Fixes render-pass pointer initialization and adds a targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary drivers from 42 up to, but not including, 56. Native synchronous submission now accounts for fence-wait failures; GRContext.Submit remains void and exposes no new managed result. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select cdecl, matching the existing DllImport convention. Package revision 14.4.0.200 continues to bundle native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

## Release Candidate 2 (November 13, 2026)

Corrects transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles, stale atlas work after empty flushes, Graphite clip-pass capacity and displacement precision. Native Vulkan submission accounts for synchronous fence-wait failures, but GRContext.Submit still exposes no result.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection, and adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM Vulkan drivers. Managed APIs are unchanged.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport metadata. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, subject to any higher framework minimums; HarfBuzzSharp's package revision changes without a native engine upgrade.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.1...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
